description: Tropical storm (7 event data sets, WFP Automated Disaster Analysis & Mapping, on HDX) is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by WFP Automated Disaster Analysis & Mapping. ADAM ID: 1001154\ 34 Tropical storm during the period Mar 08 2025-Mar 16 2025 in Mozambique, Madagascar. The center of the storm was located near latitude -26.04 longitude 51.93. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies. Coverage: Cabo Verde, Madagascar, Mozambique. The portal lists 7 near-identical data sets in this series (one per event, year, area or country), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher WFP Automated Disaster Analysis & Mapping. Its tags are affected population, cyclones-hurricanes-typhoons, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, SHP. The portal shows 2026-05-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
